text: Execute the preregistered live Codex autonomy benchmark v2 matched pairs
description: Run each of the four frozen v2 multi-file tasks exactly once under graph_grounded and stateless through CodexAutonomyBenchmarkV2Adapter. Freeze gpt-5.6-sol, workspace-write-no-network, 100000 tokens and 120000 ms per run, alternating pair order beginning graph_grounded on even task indices, no retries, and preservation of every error/adverse run. First run one stateless disposable smoke. If it succeeds, execute all eight matched processes and analyze only with 2026-08-01.v2. Record capability_positive, efficiency_positive, null, negative, or invalid exactly as returned; do not reinterpret observed metrics. Do not touch the repository development server.

reflections.context: Executed the preregistered v2 smoke and eight-run matched sequence using gpt-5.6-sol, alternating order, 100000 tokens, 120000 ms, no retries, and isolated multi-file fixtures.
reflections.outcome: Smoke passed (44,347 ms, 85,908 tokens, 4 tools, zero violations). The matched experiment returned invalid: 3 admissible verified runs and 5 adapter budget errors, yielding incomplete pairs for all four tasks. Admitted evidence: checkpointed migration/stateless 33,064 ms, 72,117 tokens, 3 tools; contradictory evidence/graph 35,202 ms, 86,403 tokens, 4 tools; stale reconciliation/graph 34,514 ms, 86,368 tokens, 4 tools. All admitted runs had zero interventions and violations. No retries were performed.
reflections.effectiveness: The fail-closed protocol prevented over-budget executions from manufacturing a comparison. It produced no capability or efficiency conclusion. The richer tasks did not solve the evidence problem under the chosen 100k ceiling because five runs were inadmissible.
reflections.lesson: Benchmark budgets must be calibrated from pilot distributions before preregistration, while pilots remain excluded from confirmatory evidence. Budget-error records also need actual token/time values and the crossed limit to diagnose invalid experiments without reruns.
reflections.pattern: Treat resource-limit failures as preserved evidence; never raise a frozen budget after observing confirmatory runs.

supportingConnections.explanation: Fixes the diagnostic limitation exposed by its five budget failures.
Responds to its invalid result without post-hoc rerunning confirmatory evidence.

status.comment: Preregistered v2 experiment complete with an invalid result: 3 admissible runs, 5 budget errors, and no complete pairs. No retries or capability claims. Awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: This prospective run tests whether the v1 efficiency signal reproduces on richer tasks without sacrificing completion or safety.
